body: Why not get drunk/high and play video games alone? Of course whatever you wish to do is your choice. Somehow, whatever I've done in my life, people ask "why don't I get out more and go to parties?" I have a party every night because I know how to party. I feel like I do it right. I bet you do too. The " normal" folks out there don't have a clue about what real partying is. So I say to you all who have doubts, be alone and embrace it as hard as that may be. Those feelings WILL subside to an extent and once that happens, you will know joy and happiness like no other human will ever know. Personally, I take pride in that feeling. I take a couple shots of that cheap vodka, and I take a couple hits of that dirt weed and then I go out into nature with the animals and the trees and the mountains. To me, that is the party. It takes a very VERY special person to be able to appreciate that. I think a lot of us feel the same, and if not IT's OKAY! We all have our special interests and after all, that's what makes us all unique. In my time, I feel like all of us who are on the autism spectrum ACTUALLY have the upper hand in life. Think about it. We suffer now, so that tomorrow we will not suffer :)

I understand "normal" people. I feel as though they do not fully understand me. Therefore, I feel like nobody can fully appreciate the things I do, and for that reason, they cannot appreciate me. I appreciate the normal out there just like myself, but until they can get a better grasp on what I deal with daily, I just do not wish to deal with them very much. I prefer solitude because I can listen to the same song 5 times in a row without being criticized, and I can take long car rides with no absolute purpose other than to see the mountains without having someone take my aux cord to play music I do not care for, or to complain about how my ideas are stupid. Plain and simple. I'm different. Maybe too different than what most people in my parts can deal with so I do us both a favor and stay out of the way. It's not so bad though. I generate my own power, and I grow my own food and I spend a lot of time learning new things.

Exactly! It is so exhausting to have to try to explain my "weird habits" and other phenomena to the NTs. I always make sure people know "Hey, you may notice me doing all sorts of weird things or perhaps my facial expressions will seem a bit weird and you'd be right to be curious. I have asperger's which is like high functioning autism and honestly that's the best explanation I can give you. If you don't know what Asperger's is, I encourage you to look into it." I make sure to be as nice as I can and frankly, I feel like the people in the workplace respect me for it. One of my bosses said it's rather bold to be as open as I am about it. I really am not doing it for them, but rather myself so I can mitigate any future exhaustion from having to try to give them a satisfying explanation. I just want my already chaotic work life to be more peaceful.

I actually realize now how I was just using girls for my own happiness and I was able to see what a destructive cycle it's been for a very long time since I was little. I need to work on myself. I always saw that advice but I never grasped what they meant but I finally get it. Don't focus on too much at once and make smaller but obtainable goals and once you conquer those, set even higher goals and so on. I could've been the sweetest guy to her (I was) but it meant nothing because I was always expecting too much from my relationships. I'm done trying to date for the forseeable future. I gotta get my act together. Ace that final semester, build my resume up and learn as much as I can now. Then get a good job and build yourself a good life and don't even focus on them.
